# Getting help

- **Download or install:** start with the [README](../README.md#download) and [latest release](https://github.com/glimapp/glim/releases/latest).
- **Questions and ideas:** use [Discussions](https://github.com/glimapp/glim/discussions). English and Chinese are welcome.
- **Bugs and format requests:** use the [issue forms](https://github.com/glimapp/glim/issues/new/choose). Include version, platform, and a sanitized example when possible.
- **Security vulnerabilities:** follow the [private reporting policy](../SECURITY.md).

Glim is maintained as an open-source project. Response times vary; there is no support SLA. See the [format limits](../docs/file-format-support.md) and [roadmap](../docs/TODO.md) for current boundaries.
